title: First Day Of Issue Scott Rough Riders U.S. Postage Stamp 3¢ - Used On Envelope
descriptionText: The product is a First Day of Issue Scott Rough Riders U.S. postage stamp with a denomination of 3¢. This stamp was used on an envelope and originates from the United States. The cancellation type is First Day of Issue, and it is ungraded and uncertified. This collectible item allows for the preservation and appreciation of American philatelic history, particularly from the early 20th century.
